home.name: Columbus on the Cheap events (by page)
home.goodFor: day-by-day listings ~5 days per page (/events/view-all/2/, /3/ ...). Best source for dated kids events every day: storytimes, workshops, Metro Parks, Santa, sensory-friendly; also markets and Studio 35 film deals. Skip the all-day 'deal roundup' entries

home.name: Dead Souls of Columbus newsletter
home.goodFor: weekly goth / darkwave / 80s / Britpop club nights, incl. The Oracle (Olde Towne East) and Spacebar. Best way to catch Oracle nights; also IG @cbusgoth
